name: St Mary with St Patrick, Oldham

boundary.description: From the roundabout junction of Chadderton Way, Oldham Way and Featherstall Road South (A6048), N along A6048, Rochdale Road, Crompton Street, to its junction with Godson Street. NE by a bee-line through Oldham Edge to Higginshaw Lane (including Milne Street, but excluding Meek street) and to and S along the railway to Lees Road and by a bee-line to the footpath S of Oldham Road to Waterloo Road, Woodstock Street, Park Road and by a bee-line to Scottfield Road (including all of Eldon Street and Webster Street). Then S along Scottfield Road, Belgrave Road, Villa Road, Ashton Road, Schofield Street, Copster Hill Road, Hollins Road, Frederick Street, Manchester Street, Featherstall Road South to the roundabout.
